subject: 荆州万寿宝塔 · 八角七层砖塔全貌（自塔坑边南望）
name: 荆州万寿宝塔
sub: 明代八角七层楼阁式砖塔
yearNote: 明嘉靖二十七年（1548）辽王奉嫡母毛太妃之命为皇帝祈寿而建，历时四年竣工；清道光五年（1825）以铁箍加固外壁，1952年荆江大堤加高后底层没入堤面之下。年表取1548年。维基百科正文中辽王名字缺一字，本条不补写。
place: 湖北 · 荆州 · 沙市
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q10864999（万寿宝塔）P625 坐标 30.3175, 112.224722，塔本体近似坐标，非本项目测绘；地图显示点复用新建的 hb_jingzhou。
lede: 沙市荆江大堤的观音矶头上，万寿宝塔面对长江而立。明嘉靖二十七年（1548）辽王奉嫡母毛太妃之命为皇帝祈寿建塔，四年竣工，八角七层，高40.46米。1952年大堤加高后，塔的底层没入堤面之下，今天要走进一圈石栏围起的塔坑，才看得到它的全身。
facts: 明嘉靖二十七年（1548）辽王奉毛太妃之命建塔为皇帝祈寿，历时四年竣工；清道光五年（1825）以铁箍加固外壁，1956年列省保，2006年列第六批国保。
八角七层楼阁式砖石塔，高40.46米；塔基为石质须弥座，高1.14米、边长5.9米；塔身中空，内有石砌旋梯通往顶层，各层塔门均朝南。
各层腰檐下砖雕仿木斗栱，每面辟佛龛嵌佛像，底层转角有石雕力士；1952年荆江大堤加高后底层没入堤面之下，今以塔坑与石栏环绕。
caption: 荆州万寿宝塔
明 · 1548年建
structure_checkpoints: 八角形平面、七层：每层以一道出挑的腰檐（檐下一排砖雕仿木斗栱）和其上的平座分层，层高自下而上递减，塔身逐层收分；主图自上而下可数七层腰檐。
底层在堤面以下的塔坑中，正面开一门，门上横匾（留白）；底层每面有多个方形佛龛与石雕像，转角处有力士像；二层以上每面正中一龛或一拱形小窗，佛龛留轮廓即可。
塔顶为八角攒尖，顶上葫芦形塔刹（补充图可见）；塔坑四周为一圈石栏杆与碑廊，线稿可简化为一道低矮栏杆或省去。
画面去除：周围树木、碑廊的碑刻细节、远处围墙与建筑、游人；保持塔身竖直，以塔为中心。
material_observations: 塔身青灰色砖砌，砖面风化泛白、带苔痕；腰檐与斗栱砖色略深；佛龛内石像灰白；底层石砌须弥座灰褐；塔刹灰黑；塔坑栏杆白石，碑廊蓝灰色。
author: Zhangzhugang

Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: the Wanshou Pagoda of Jingzhou (Shashi), an octagonal SEVEN-storey brick pagoda (Image 2 from the rim of the sunken pit; Image 3 is the full tower from a distance for silhouette; Image 4 is the ground storey for niche detail). Draw all seven storeys: each storey separated by a projecting eave with a row of small imitation brackets beneath it and a narrow balcony-like ledge above; storeys shorten and the shaft narrows towards the top; the first storey is tallest, with one doorway at the front centre and a blank tablet above it, several rectangular niches with seated figures across its faces and a guardian figure at each corner; upper storeys show one small niche or arched opening at the centre of each visible face. Crown the pagoda with an octagonal pyramidal roof and a gourd-shaped finial. The base stands in a sunken pit—show only a simple low stone balustrade around the pit or omit it. Omit trees, the inscription gallery, distant walls and people. Portrait format, apex and base uncut.
